opening.argument: The video shows Facebook Business Help categories and a contact-support option while the speaker explains how to reach Facebook support. The discussion stays with ordinary support problems: billing, payments, ads, and page or admin access. A reported support response describes waiting for and accepting a page-administrator request. Together, those details establish an instructional Facebook Ads support demonstration. The material does not make financial participation, credential submission, or a deceptive benefit claim a condition for viewers; it presents a process for getting help with an existing business-page problem.
